versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text: (see also USAR.1843 Fuel quantity data) Where a fuel quantity indicator is installed on the UAV for use by the ground staff, a red radial line must be marked on each indicator at the calibrated zero reading.
